service_name: Housing Allocation Scheme (choice-based lettings, ELLC Choice Homes)
description: Council and housing association homes let through bidding (up to two bids a cycle) and direct offers, ranked by priority group and waiting time
eligibility: Age 18+, 3 years' continuous Newham residence (waived if owed a Part 7 homelessness duty by Newham). Excludes people restricted by immigration status, households placed in Newham by another council, and some behaviour cases
uptake_evidence: 711 new social lettings in Newham in 2024/25 (CORE Table 1d). 25 households' main duty ended by accepting a Part 6 social housing offer, Jan-Mar 2026 (MD2)
notes: Lettings are all new social lets, not only to homeless households. One unreasonable refusal can end the homelessness duty (p.15).

service_name: Private rented sector offer to end the main duty
description: The main homelessness duty is usually ended by an offer of a private rented home. One offer, expected to be accepted on the day it is made
uptake_evidence: 36 households' main duty ended by accepting a private rented sector offer, Jan-Mar 2026; none refused (MD2)
notes: A duty ending is not proof of a lasting settled home.

description: The council guarantees rent to private landlords for up to a year where a resident cannot provide evidence of income
eligibility: Households moving out of the borough (listed under relocation support)

description: Newham takes part in London-wide schemes that source private rented homes for homeless households
notes: From the 2021-26 strategy; current participation not checked.

service_name: Housing association lease: 21 homes at LHA rents
description: Leasing agreement giving 21 private sector homes at Local Housing Allowance rents, let on two-year assured shorthold tenancies to suitable households in TA
Dedicated officers help residents secure and settle into long-term homes, with information on housing options
Support to use Homefinder UK to find secure tenancies outside Newham
eligibility: Households wanting to move out of the borough
uptake_evidence: Over 30 Newham households had used the service (strategy, at time of writing)
notes: Moving to another borough generally removes the household from Newham's housing register (GR summary, citing Newham web pages).

description: Support when moving into a private rented home found with council help: payments set up, regular contact, and liaison with the landlord
eligibility: People moving into private renting with council help

service_name: Crisis and Resilience Fund: deposit or rent in advance
description: Lump sums for a deposit or rent in advance, normally no more than one month's Local Housing Allowance
eligibility: As set out in the CRF Housing Payment Policy
notes: Read via GR's summary; the CRF policy document is not in the repo.

service_name: Crisis and Resilience Fund: housing payments for TA households hit by the benefit cap
description: Priority 2 awards for households in TA (s188 or s193) affected by the benefit cap, usually for 3 months and tied to steps to become exempt from the cap
eligibility: Households in TA affected by the benefit cap
notes: Read via GR's summary. The benefit cap mainly affects larger families, but the scheme is not family-specific.

service_name: Property Identified by Resident: deposit or rent in advance
description: Residents can find their own private rental and submit a form; the council checks the property and can help with a deposit or rent in advance
notes: Read via GR's summary of Newham's web pages.
